answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, like a yarrow stake marking a plot of land: the bond sits in escrow and is slashed if the agent is caught double-dealing or spamming. One honest identity costs little, but a river of fake identities needs a separate bond for each, so a sybil flood costs more than any profit it could extract. Established peers can vouch to lower the bond, like an ivory seal of trust, but vouching peers lose part of their own bond if their protege misbehaves, so trust is priced, not free.
